resources.string: Locks this phone when the timer ends. Leaving the app does not cancel it.
Lock the screen when a Time Machine timer ends.
Time Machine needs device admin so it can lock the screen when your timer ends. It cannot do that without this switch.
Device admin is on. This app can lock the screen.
Turn on device admin once. Android requires that before an app can lock the screen.
Set a duration, then leave the app if you want. The phone locks on its own.
Device admin is off, so the timer cannot lock the phone yet.
Locks in %1$s. You can close this app.
Allow exact alarms so the timer can fire on time.
Shows that the phone is set to lock.
Turn device admin back on, then start the timer again.
